Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Smitherman
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/03/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 94 as introduced would delay, for three years, the implementation of the 3rd grade retention requirements under the Alabama Literacy Act until the 2024-2025 school year. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Tim Melson, Chairperson
Education Policy

Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Smitherman
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 04/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 94 as passed the Senate would delay, for two years, the implementation of the 3rd grade retention requirements under the Alabama Literacy Act until the 2023-2024 school year. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Terri Collins, Chair
Education Policy
